subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Does a CI/security owner approve these exact third-party GitHub Action revisions for execution in OpenClaw workflows that receive private keys, registry credentials, or OpenAI API keys?
rationale: The branch changes executable supply-chain inputs on privileged automation paths; this trust decision cannot be established from the Dependabot diff or routine checks alone.

options.title: Audit and approve the revised pins
options.body: Review the upstream commits and their use in each credential-bearing workflow, then record approval before merging.

options.title: Split or pause privileged updates
options.body: Remove the secret-bearing action revisions from this grouped bump and land only the independently approved low-privilege updates, or pause the PR.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the revised pins
recommendation.body: Review the upstream commits and their use in each credential-bearing workflow, then record approval before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely escalation point for a repository-wide workflow and release-security decision; file-level ownership is not established by the available evidence.
